paragraphs: Propelus sells professional management software for the workforce that serves healthcare, aimed at practitioners themselves as well as the employers, regulators, educators and partners around them. The company groups that work under four named products.

CE Broker takes on continuing education, so that the credits a professional earns are less of a paperwork exercise. Immuware handles the tracking of employee health records for an organization. Data Solutions supplies data the company positions as a defense against fraud.

Propelus puts the reach of its tools at more than five million professionals and organizations working in healthcare. One published story follows a dental hygiene program director who used CE Broker to upload and self report her continuing education credits so they were counted and tracked. Another follows a social worker who leaned on it to stay organized against her licensure requirements.

quote.text: Our platform makes professional management simpler and more effective for professionals, employers, regulators, educators, and partners.
